metrics.name: buyers_by_country
metrics.description: How many buyers per country and their average preference score
metrics.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS buyers, ROUND(AVG(preference_score), 2) AS avg_score FROM data GROUP BY country ORDER BY buyers DESC, country

metrics.name: budget_by_category
metrics.description: Total monthly budget per preferred category
metrics.sql: SELECT preferred_category, COUNT(*) AS buyers, SUM(monthly_budget) AS total_budget FROM data GROUP BY preferred_category ORDER BY total_budget DESC, preferred_category

metrics.name: channel_by_age_group
metrics.description: Preferred contact channel per age group
metrics.sql: SELECT age_group, preferred_channel, COUNT(*) AS buyers FROM data GROUP BY age_group, preferred_channel ORDER BY age_group, buyers DESC, preferred_channel

metrics.name: newsletter_share
metrics.description: Share of buyers who take the newsletter
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE newsletter) AS subscribed, COUNT(*) AS all_buyers FROM data
